noop: None of the remaining lever settings has a realistic chance of passing the gate. To be kept, a round must beat the best so far by more than epsilon: first-action p50 under 535ms (best 585), or quality above 0.5455 (best 0.5155), with premature_transfers at 12 or fewer. Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite gives the same output on every run: all 74 failures repeated across r1/r2/r3, and temperature 0.0 in round 6 left quality unchanged (delta 0.000) at 620ms. Raising temperature to 0.7 can only add variance, which risks extra premature transfers (epsilon 0). It cannot fix the 6 end-bucket samples that end too early, the 3 that miss end_call, or the 4 that transfer prematurely (S15/S17/S20/S23). Lowering max_completion_tokens to 256 or 512 cannot affect first-action latency because replies average ~57 tokens, and it risks cutting off scripted closings. The gateway route is measured at +40-130ms. Every model swap tried has failed. gpt-5-4-mini scored 0.40 (speak_and_act=0: the scripted line and the tool call came in separate responses). qwen3-next scored 0.33 at 1192ms and llama-4-maverick 0.33. deepseek-v4-1-flash scored 0.538 (+0.023 vs best, below the 0.03 epsilon) and was slower at 674ms. The untested models are gpt-5-4-nano (same family as mini, so expect speak_and_act ~0 and quality ~0.40), llama-3.1-8b (weaker than maverick, which already scored 0.33) and qwen35-122b-a10b (a Qwen like qwen3-next at 1192ms, likely slower than Gemini). None plausibly clears the quality floor while also beating 535ms. Also, the 585ms best is probably a lucky draw: Gemini's own runs span 585-682ms, a spread of about 100ms, twice the epsilon. Gemini repeats show no quality variation, and on latency only a lucky draw could pass the gate. Recommendation for the user: the levers are close to exhausted for this objective set.
